title: Janakiraman
desc: Two brothers remain sworn to bachelorhood. However, chaos arises when a man tries to get them married to his daughters.

title: Theertha Karaiyinile
desc: A man meets a tuberculosis patient at death's door, and goes to his village.

title: Arumugasamy
desc: A priest and his daughter are exiled after temple jewels go missing. The village head later discovers the priest's innocence and searches for him.

title: Kadavul Amaitha Medai
desc: A couple living in a small town get the shock of their lives when their son returns with a woman whom he wants to marry. They agree, but soon problems arise in the household.

title: Pasanga 2
desc: Kavin and Naina are expelled from several schools due to their hyperactive behaviour. Their frustrated parents accidentally meet Thamizh, a psychiatrist, who becomes a saviour for their children.
